claims.evidence: Photos show only stacked used tires; no signage, business documents, or legible Belgium branding is visible.

risks.risk: Tread depth and remaining usable life cannot be assessed from the photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tread depth gauges or wear bars on multiple tires.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn-out or scrap rubber.

risks.risk: Manufacture date or age is unknown; DOT codes are not visible.
risks.proof: Clear photos of sidewall DOT date codes on several tires.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as aged rubber with uncertain remaining life.

risks.risk: It is unknown whether the tires hold air or have punctures.
risks.proof: Video or photo showing a tire inflated and holding pressure, or a leak test.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not holding air or punctured.

risks.risk: History of repairs or patches is not shown.
risks.proof: Close-up inspection of inner liners and sidewalls for patch marks.

risks.risk: Exact tire size and specifications are not legible.
risks.proof: Clear photo of sidewall size markings (width, aspect ratio, rim diameter).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown or mismatched size.

risks.risk: Brand and model names are not legible in the photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of sidewall branding and model lettering.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unbranded or unknown make.

proof_requests: Close-up of sidewall DOT date codes
Video of tire inflation or leak test
Close-up of tread depth on multiple tires
Clear photo of sidewall size markings
Close-up of brand and model lettering
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as used car tires, allowing a worst-case price; the seller's distributor and Belgium-origin claim cannot be verified from the photos and is marked unverifiable_remote.
